python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,tarfile,time
assert os.environ.get("SLURM_JOB_ID")
root=pathlib.Path("/fact_home/bohanli/RL_Placement/experiments/flowplace_fql")
p=root/"backend/references/released_flow_embedded_versions_v1.json"
x=json.loads(p.read_text())
archive=root/"backend/assets/OpenROAD-flow-scripts.tar.gz"
h=hashlib.sha256()
with archive.open("rb") as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b""):h.update(b)
assert h.hexdigest()==x["source_archive_sha256"]
rows=[]
with tarfile.open(archive,"r:gz") as tar:
 members=tar.getmembers()
 for row in x["rows"]:
  relative=row["metadata"].split("OpenROAD-flow-scripts/",1)[1]
  choices=[m for m in members if m.name==relative or m.name.endswith("/"+relative)]
  assert len(choices)==1,(relative,len(choices))
  data=tar.extractfile(choices[0]).read()
  assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row["metadata_sha256"]
  suffix="results/nangate45/"+row["design"]+"/eval/1_synth.v"
  candidates=[m for m in members if m.name==suffix or m.name.endswith("/"+suffix)]
  assert len(candidates)==1
  header=tar.extractfile(candidates[0]).readline().decode().strip()
  assert header==row["synth_netlist_header"]
  rows.append({"design":row["design"],"metadata_member":choices[0].name,"synth_member":candidates[0].name,"verified":True})
out=root/"backend/references/released_flow_embedded_versions_archive_audit_v1.json"
assert not out.exists()
out.write_text(json.dumps({"source_reference_sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"archive_sha256":h.hexdigest(),"slurm_job_id":os.environ["SLURM_JOB_ID"],"time":time.time(),"rows":rows,"all_six_verified":len(rows)==6},indent=2)+"\n")
print(out)
'
